facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-4104 during a breakdown response

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4104, HX-4120 and PT-4104 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4104, HX-4120 and PT-4104 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. P-4104 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 7 October 2024 an incident occurred on P-4104, HX-4120 and PT-4104 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
